newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BOSNICH HAS HEARING ON FRIDAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOSNICH HAS HEARING ON FRIDAY.

text.p: Aston Villa goalkeeper Mark Bosnich will appear before an F.A. disciplinary commission on Friday to answer a misconduct charge over a Hitler-style salute last month.
The Australian angered Tottenham supporters - many of whom are Jewish - when he made the gesture during the second half of a match at White Hart Lane on October 12.
Bosnich is still waiting to hear if he will be charged after a report was sent last week to the Crown Prosecution Service.

He has since tried to diffuse the situation, issuing a statement and claiming his action was basically a joke which back-fired. He has also travelled to London to apologise in person to Spurs chairman Alan Sugar.
But the F.A. commission could still hit him with a fine and a suspension.
Police have said it may be several weeks before they make a decision on whether to charge Bosnich.a
